subject: Tiered remit routing & tax breakdown for Q2 Redwood invoice
messages:
From: Luke Porter <luke.porter@novahealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: finance@novahealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: invoicing for Q2 pilot - entity split / VAT questions

Hi Soojin / Redwood team,

Quick background: Nova Health will be running a pilot across US and EU entities next quarter. Our treasury needs clarity on how Redwood will present a single billing run where some line items are chargeable to Nova Health US (NOVA-US) and others to Nova Health Europe (NOVA-EU). EU items will likely be subject to reverse-charge VAT, while US items are standard taxable/untaxed depending on jurisdiction.

Two asks up front:
- Can Redwood produce a single consolidated invoice PDF for our accounts payable, with an attached CSV that maps each line item to the legal entity and VAT treatment?
- If you cannot, what is the minimum acceptable split (one invoice per legal entity vs. one invoice with split lines)?

We also need a sample remit matrix so we can plug into our AR system. Target for Q2 billing: invoice date 2027-04-30, payment terms NET30.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Luke
Luke Porter
Head of Finance Operations
Nova Health
attachments: none

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Luke Porter <luke.porter@novahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: invoicing for Q2 pilot - entity split / VAT questions

Hi Luke — thanks for the clear summary. We can support both approaches, but there are trade-offs: single consolidated PDF + split-line detail (CSV) is the most AP-friendly for customers who want one document, while issuing separate invoices per legal entity is simpler on our billing side and cleaner for tax reporting.

Proposed approach (for Nova Health pilot):
- Issue one consolidated invoice PDF for AP visibility
- Attach a machine-readable CSV that contains: line_id, description, amount, currency, legal_entity_code (NOVA-US/NOVA-EU), cost_center, VAT_treatment (taxable/reverse_charge/exempt), and GL_account mapping.
- For the EU reverse-charge lines we will mark VAT rate = 0 and set VAT_note = "reverse charge - customer liable"; include your EU VAT ID in the CSV header.
- Redwood will also export a per-entity accounting summary (CSV) suitable for your ERP to post AR entries.

I've attached a remit matrix template and a short draft of the line-item CSV schema so you can confirm mappings. If you prefer separate invoices, we can switch but will need the legal_entity PO numbers up front.

Next steps:
1) Could you send the legal entity codes and POs (if any)?
2) Confirm whether Nova prefers one consolidated invoice PDF or separate invoices.

I copied Marissa and Ben from our billing ops so they can weigh in on scheduling and tax handling.

Best,
Soogin Lee
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_remit_matrix_v2.xlsx; Q2_lineitem_schema.csv

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Luke Porter <luke.porter@novahealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: invoicing for Q2 pilot - entity split / VAT questions

Adding details from billing ops / finance so the deliverable is operationally clear.

Billing ops recommendations:
- Preferred: single invoice PDF + two machine-readable attachments (1. per-line CSV, 2. per-entity settlement CSV). This aligns with most ERPs and keeps AP happy.
- If Nova requires legal-entity-level invoices for audit reasons, we'll issue two PDF invoices (NOVA-US & NOVA-EU) and include cross-reference IDs so your AR can reconcile to the consolidated billing statement.

Cost center & GL mapping: please confirm the cost_center codes you want in the CSV. If you send a PO per cost center we'll map automatically. Otherwise, we can accept a mapping table (cost center -> legal_entity) and apply it at invoice generation.

Tax/VAT specifics (EU):
- For reverse-charge lines we will populate VAT_rate=0, VAT_amount=0, VAT_reason_code=RC.
- We'll include a VAT summary block in the invoice footer for auditors: your EU VAT ID, which lines were reverse-charged, and total amounts per VAT treatment.

Attachments: "remit_matrix_v2.xlsx" (template with bank coordinates and legal entity codes) and a draft "Q2_lineitem_breakdown.csv" sample.

Operational timeline:
- If we receive PO/entity mapping by EOD Tue 2027-04-12, we can produce invoice drafts by 2027-04-20 and final by 2027-04-30.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: remit_matrix_v2.xlsx; Q2_lineitem_breakdown.csv

From: Luke Porter <luke.porter@novahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: finance@novahealth.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: invoicing for Q2 pilot - entity split / VAT questions

Thanks — that works. Confirming Nova Health preference: single consolidated PDF for AP, with two machine-readable attachments (1) the CSV mapping each line to legal_entity and VAT treatment; (2) per-entity settlement CSV for our ledger team. We will provide:
- Legal entity codes: NOVA-US / NOVA-EU
- EU VAT ID: EU-987654321
- Cost center mapping (attached) and POs for NOVA-US lines only (we'll send PO numbers by Tue).

Important: for audit reasons our internal policy requires the CSV to include a column "entity_invoice_ref" that we can use to link each split line back to the consolidated PDF (so we can store a single PDF and reconcile automatically). Can Redwood include that?

If you can include the entity_invoice_ref in the per-line CSV, and confirm the reverse-charge markup in PDF footer, we are set. Target: please share the invoice draft PDF + CSVs for review by 2027-04-20.

If anything changes we'll loop in procurement@novahealth.com.

Luke
Luke Porter
Head of Finance Operations
Nova Health
attachments: sample_cost_center_map.csv
